test_search_with_valid_license_name.title: Verify searching a feature's full name lists only rows carrying that name

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and note the first feature's name.
steps.expected: A named row in the Available table.

steps.action: Type that name into the search box.
steps.expected: At least one row is listed, every listed row's feature contains the name, and no row reads No Data!.

test_search_with_partial_keyword.title: Verify a partial feature name filters to the rows containing it

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and note the first feature's name.
steps.expected: A named row in the Available table.

steps.action: Type the first four letters of that name into the search box.
steps.expected: The first feature is still listed and every listed row contains those letters.

test_search_with_license_key.title: Verify searching an Available count lists the features with that count

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and note the first feature's Available number.
Type that number into the search box.
steps.expected: The first feature is still listed and every listed row's Available (or its name) contains the number.

test_invalid_search_shows_no_results.title: Verify a term that matches nothing leaves only the No Data! row

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and type ZZZZNONEXISTENT999 into the search box.
steps.expected: The table shows exactly one row and it reads No Data!; no feature row remains.

test_clear_search_restores_list.title: Verify clearing the search brings back exactly the rows shown before it

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and note every row of the Available table.
Type ZZZZNONEXISTENT999 into the search box.
steps.expected: Only the No Data! row is shown.
The table shows the same rows as in step 1, in the same order.

test_empty_search_does_not_filter.title: Verify an empty search term changes nothing in the table

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and note every row of the Available table.
Click into the search box and leave it empty.
steps.expected: The table still shows the same rows.

test_csv_download_option_available.title: Verify the Licenses page offers one Download control, labelled as such

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and look at the controls above the table.
steps.expected: Exactly one download icon, whose alt text reads Download, is shown.

test_csv_download_triggers_file.title: Verify clicking Download produces a CSV export

steps.action: Open Admin > Licenses and click the Download icon.
steps.expected: The browser receives a file whose name ends in .csv.
